# Run the main pipeline

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  eval = FALSE
)
```

Run the command below to process the example `immune_human_2x` aggregation and produce a multimodal Seurat object. Note that this object is primarily a convenience object, since the pipeline does not use Seurat under-the-hood to do the actual processing, but instead relies n the high-performant BPCells package. Using 16 logical threads on an AMD EPYC 7543, this process takes <25 minutes to run and produces a total of 6 GBs data on disk.

```{.r filename="R"}
targets::tar_make(tidyselect::matches("multimodal_Seurat_object.immune_human_2x"))
```
